sentence: This project builds methods that help drones and other autonomous systems adapt their controllers to new tasks while staying safe.
This project uses sensors in the water distribution network to build computer models that forecast lapses in water quality.
This project studies the origins of noise in transistors that could be used to measure the qubit state in quantum computing.
This project uses cameras and other instruments to study how lightning initiates and propagates across the electromagnetic spectrum.
This project uses deep-sea sediment cores to study how climate shifts influenced iceberg discharge events and ocean circulation in the past.
This project builds a tool that confines infrared light beneath a sharp metal-coated tip to study molecules at surfaces.
This project uses the fossil record of Jamaica to measure how ancient biodiversity was shaped by environmental changes before and after human colonization.
This project develops countermeasures against attacks that exploit memory disclosure vulnerabilities to harvest reusable code.
This project studies how living systems respond to stress such as drought, freezing, wildfire, and pollution.
This project builds technology that uses extended reality to help workers with complex precision machining and inspection tasks.
This project addresses gaps in data network capacity and connectivity at five participating institutions.
This project studies the security and privacy of mobile data on smartphones and in mobile clouds.
This project studies how scaffold proteins recruit a key protein to the location where a fission yeast cell will divide.
This project builds a structured pathway from high school to college for biotechnology.
This project studies how surface productivity affects marine benthic communities on both sides of the modern Isthmus of Panama.
This project studies how light causes atoms and molecules to rearrange or break apart.
This project builds peptide ligands that capture inactive Cas protein from lysates and release active CRISPR complexes when guide RNA is added.
